rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts must exist before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs remain unique; repairs 071 and 074 stay preserved.
rule_descriptions.SCHEMA_RESOURCE_DISCOVERY: Collection schema, queryables and sortables are discovered explicitly before attribute assumptions.
rule_descriptions.QUERYABLE_PROPERTY_GATE: A metadata attribute may be used in a filter only when its queryability is established.
rule_descriptions.ACTUAL_VALID_DOMAIN_GATE: Actual-domain and valid-domain constraints are not conflated.
rule_descriptions.SCHEMA_FORMAT_INDEPENDENCE: Logical schema semantics are independent from GeoJSON/JSON-FG/GML representation.
rule_descriptions.RECORD_CATALOG_ROLE: Catalog record discovery is not the same as a contributing-survey feature match.
rule_descriptions.RECORD_FILTER_AND_GATE: Record filter plus bbox/datetime/other predicates must all match before inclusion.
rule_descriptions.RECORD_SORT_ROLE: Record sorting changes result ordering only; it does not increase authority or accuracy.
rule_descriptions.JSONFG_CRS_ROLE: JSON-FG projected CRS support preserves coordinates but does not prove native raster sampling.
rule_descriptions.JSONFG_TIME_ROLE: JSON-FG time members preserve temporal semantics but do not prove acquisition lineage.
rule_descriptions.JSONFG_SCHEMA_ROLE: JSON-FG feature-schema links describe structure and do not validate values.
rule_descriptions.DSP_METADATA_ROLE: Dataset metadata describes context, uses and limitations rather than numeric terrain observations.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_AVAILABILITY: Metadata/coverage availability is discovery evidence, not exact contributing-survey identity.
rule_descriptions.EA_COVERAGE_ABSENCE: No listed survey coverage remains absence/unknown and is never converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.EA_INDEX_SURVEY_ID: Exact composite contributor requires survey-id match from EA metadata index.
rule_descriptions.EA_INDEX_SPATIAL_MATCH: Parcel/tile must intersect the candidate survey footprint.
rule_descriptions.EA_INDEX_TEMPORAL_MATCH: Survey temporal attributes must be kept distinct from dataset revision/publication dates.
rule_descriptions.EA_INDEX_RESOLUTION_MATCH: Source resolution is a lineage attribute and must not be inferred from requested output resolution.
rule_descriptions.EA_INDEX_TRANSFORM_MATCH: Survey transform/geoid metadata must be preserved for historical comparisons.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_BBOX_CRS_GATE: bbox-crs transformation is query processing and not native raster evidence.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_FILTER_GATE: CQL2/filter predicates select candidate metadata features only.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_QUERYABLES_GATE: Queryables define usable filter properties; absent queryability fails closed.
rule_descriptions.CQL2_SYNTAX_NOT_AUTHORITY: Valid CQL2 syntax is not source authority.
rule_descriptions.COMPOSITE_RESAMPLING: EA composite bilinear resampling remains explicit and is not called native observation.
rule_descriptions.DTM_DSM_ROLE: DSM/first-return models remain excluded from bare-earth primary extrema.
rule_descriptions.WMS_WCS_ROLE: WMS portrayal remains excluded from numeric sampling.
rule_descriptions.PERSISTENT_ENDPOINT_ROLE: Persistent endpoint identity does not freeze contributing-survey lineage.
rule_descriptions.GROUND_TRUTH_ROLE: EA ground-truth points validate survey QC, not parcel terrain.
rule_descriptions.LIDAR_ABSOLUTE_RMSE: EA absolute vertical RMSE is not a parcel confidence interval.
rule_descriptions.LIDAR_RELATIVE_ERROR: EA relative/random error is distinct from absolute datum error.
rule_descriptions.POINT_DENSITY_ROLE: Point density is distinct from raster cell resolution.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_CELL_MEAN: OS Terrain5 values are cell means and remain secondary evidence.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_PIXEL_CENTER: Terrain5 pixel-center convention is storage/sampling semantics, not accuracy.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_STORAGE_PRECISION: Stored decimal precision is not vertical accuracy.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_METADATA_VERSION: Tile version/reason-for-change is publication lineage, not parcel acquisition date.
rule_descriptions.TERRAIN5_SOURCE_TIN: Source TIN/RMSE context is secondary and cannot replace EA 1m DTM.
rule_descriptions.TITLE_PLAN_GENERAL_EXTENT: Title-plan general extent is not an exact legal boundary.
rule_descriptions.DETERMINED_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE: Exact legal-boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_ROLE: HMLR horizontal legal-survey tolerances are not LiDAR vertical RMSE.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_AUTHORITY_CHAIN: Register, title plan and filed documents are kept in their legal roles.
rule_descriptions.CIS_DOMAIN_RANGE: Coverage domain and range mapping must remain structurally consistent.
rule_descriptions.REFERENCEABLE_GRID_ROLE: Referenceable grid is not silently assumed to be a rectified native raster grid.
rule_descriptions.GPKG_COVERAGE_ROLE: GeoPackage coverage encoding/scale/offset/null semantics do not certify accuracy.
rule_descriptions.JSONFG_ENCODING_NOT_ACCURACY: JSON-FG encoding does not improve RMSE or survey authority.
rule_descriptions.RECORD_ENCODING_NOT_AUTHORITY: Record/feature encoding is separate from provenance authority.
rule_descriptions.CRS_HORIZONTAL_VERTICAL: Horizontal CRS and vertical datum remain separate evidence layers.
rule_descriptions.SURVEY_DATE_ROLE: Acquisition date is not replaced by publication/revision date.
rule_descriptions.PIXEL_SELECTION_ROLE: Pixel inclusion/sampling rule remains explicit and reproducible.
rule_descriptions.POLYGON_ROLE: HMLR polygon geometry and exact legal-boundary status are not conflated.
rule_descriptions.ABSENCE_NOT_ZERO: Missing/no-data/unknown lineage is never converted to numeric zero.
rule_descriptions.UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED: Unresolved parcel-specific survey identity remains UNKNOWN.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing 1m/2m parcel measurements do not change during contract QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: Repository 96% confidence is workflow confidence, not a universal statistical guarantee.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows stay zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready stays false while a required F-host receipt is absent.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay row visibility is not live Chromium acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent branch activity.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_PROMOTION_GATE: Only official scoped evidence is promoted; semantic overreach fails closed.
rule_descriptions.CURRENTNESS_GATE: Current/version evidence selects applicable source but does not create numeric accuracy.
